meta.name: Generative Edit (MiniMax H3 Image)
meta.licenseNote: MiniMax H3 Community License (MiniMax, 2026): the grant excludes the EU, the UK, South Korea and the USA; over USD 1M yearly revenue or a hosted service needs MiniMax's OK; show "Powered by MiniMax H3"; outputs may not train other models. Bring your own files. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion minimax-h3-image/edit): picture 1 is the one edited, up to seven more follow (Picture 2 ... in the prompt). The prompt is used as written. Each picture goes to the encoder with a short edge of 1024 and through the VAE with a short edge between 1024 and 2048 as reference tokens at t = 0.999; the output takes picture 1's size after that scaling unless one is asked. Six steps, no CFG.
meta.creator: MiniMax
meta.description: Edit by instruction with up to 8 pictures, up to 16 MP (5090 class)
